Title: Stablecoins - October 2025 Research Report Design
X_tweet:
Refining two layout options for the stats screen of a mobile budgeting app where users track income, expenses, and spending patterns.

🔹 Version 1 – Time-First Flow
Select period: Daily / Weekly / Monthly
Choose: Income or Expenses
View data on area chart
See category breakdown below (e.g., Groceries, Insurance)

🔹 Version 2 – Type-First Flow
Choose: Income or Expenses
See a bar chart with time period selector
View top transactions list
Filter by category

I’m leaning toward Version 2 - starting with what you want to see (income vs. expenses) feels more intuitive than starting with time.

But I’d love your take: which flow feels more natural to you? Does chart type (area vs. bar) influence your preference?
